scientific.integrity: The primary PDF was inspected at the model, contact-function assumptions, invariant region, reproduction number, disease-free theorem and proof, and endemic-equilibrium threshold statement; the model and theorem pages were visually inspected. A full-text related SEIS paper was inspected at its equality-case global-stability theorem. The critical profile is derived analytically by a Lyapunov argument, asymptotically stable ratio equations, and the exact limit of \(\dot E/E^2\); a standalone numerical replay is corroborative only. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The theorem concerns the deterministic zero-importation reduced SEIR system exactly at the critical threshold. The sharp profile requires positive initial exposure and assumes the source's positive \(C^1\), nonincreasing contact function. No higher-order critical expansion or stochastic analogue is claimed.

title: Closed critical threshold and sharp algebraic relaxation in a vaccinated SEIR model
